query:
UPDATE anime
        SET
            title = $2,
            title_english = $3,
            title_japanese = $4,
            type = $5,
            status = $6,
            rating = $7,
            season = $8,
            source_material = $9,
            year = $10,
            month = $11,
            episode_count = $12,
            duration_seconds = $13,
            is_nsfw = $14,
            country_of_origin = $15,
            synopsis = $16,
            background = $17,
            aired_from = $18,
            aired_to = $19,
            score_weighted = $20::float8::numeric(4, 2),
            score_mean = $21::float8::numeric(4, 2),
            score_median = $22::float8::numeric(4, 2),
            version = $23,
            merged_record_hash = $24,
            hash_format = $25,
            merge_version = $26,
            merge_requested_at = NULL,
            merged_at = COALESCE(merged_at, $27),
            updated_at = $27
        WHERE id = $1
